blocker: Genuine pairing requires the owner to scan the QR from the HOSTED owner UI on a Nebius Endpoint (A20 prerequisite) and to send harmless test messages manually. No hosted deployment exists yet.

preparatory_local_observations.note: Local development image only; does NOT satisfy A19.

required_owner_actions: Complete A20 steps 1-6 (deploy/nebius/README.md) so the hosted owner UI exists
Sign in on the hosted URL from another device, Connect WhatsApp, scan the QR in WhatsApp > Linked Devices
Select one test group and one individual chat; leave another chat unselected
Send and receive harmless test messages, including one attachment, one edit and one delete-for-everyone
Exercise pause/resume, companion restart and disconnect from the Connect panel
